Customers / Booking / Rescheduling - 2 Requests in the folder
Iteration: 1 - Reschedule
Request Description
Assign a serviceman to a booking. Creates a `booking_assignment` record with status `assigned` and updates the booking's `service_man_id`.\\n\\n**Auth:** Bearer token (Console admin with `console.booking.assign` permission)\\n\\n**Path Parameters:**\\n- `booking_id` — The booking ID\\n\\n**Body (form-data):**\\n- `service_man_id` (required) — The user ID of the serviceman to assign\\n\\n**Validations:**\\n- Booking must have `booking_status = booked` (not pending, completed, or cancelled)\\n- Booking must not have an active assignment (assigned/accepted/on_way/in_progress)\\n- Serviceman must be eligible: verified, active, same zone, matching category\\n- `service_man_id` must exist in the users table\\n\\n**Response (200):**\\n`json\n{\n \"status\": true,\n \"message\": \"Serviceman assigned successfully\"\n}\n`\\n\\n**Error Examples:**\\n- `400` — "Only booked orders can be assigned to a serviceman"\\n- `400` — "This booking already has an active assignment"\\n- `400` — "Serviceman is not eligible for this booking"\\n- `422` — Validation errors for missing/invalid `service_man_id`\\n\\n**Note:** This replaces the old `GET /booking/update-service-man/{bookingId}/{userId}` endpoint. After assignment, the serviceman will see this as a pending request in their app.

Retained until consent is withdrawn or deletion is requested, subject to applicable legal obligations.<\/li>\n\n<\/ul>\n\n<h2>5. Legal and Regulatory Retention<\/h2>\n\n<p>\nNotwithstanding the retention periods specified above, Clearrcut reserves the right to retain information for a longer duration where required or permitted by applicable law, court order, regulatory authority, law enforcement agency, taxation authority, insurance provider, fraud investigation, arbitration, litigation, or any other legal proceeding.\n<\/p>\n\n<h2>6. Data Destruction<\/h2>\n\n<p>\nUpon expiry of the applicable retention period and where no legal basis exists for continued retention, personal information shall be securely deleted, anonymized, de-identified, or destroyed using industry-recognized methods designed to prevent unauthorized recovery.\n<\/p>\n\n<h2>10. USER REGISTRATION AND ACCOUNT SECURITY<\/h2><p>To access certain features of the Platform, Users may be required to create an account.<\/p><p>By registering an account, you agree to:<\/p><p>provide accurate registration details;<\/p><p>maintain updated personal information;<\/p><p>keep your login credentials confidential;<\/p><p>immediately notify the Company regarding unauthorized access;<\/p><p>remain solely responsible for all activities conducted through your account.<\/p><p>The Company shall not be liable for losses arising from unauthorized use of your account resulting from your negligence.<\/p><p>You shall not:<\/p><p>create multiple accounts to obtain promotional benefits;<\/p><p>impersonate another person;<\/p><p>use temporary or fake identities;<\/p><p>create accounts using false documents;<\/p><p>share accounts with others;<\/p><p>transfer your account without written authorization.<\/p><p>The Company may suspend or permanently terminate accounts involved in fraudulent or suspicious activities.<\/p><br><h2>6. BOOKING OF SERVICES<\/h2><p>Submission of a booking request does not constitute acceptance by the Company.<\/p><p>A booking shall be deemed confirmed only after:<\/p><p>successful system confirmation;<\/p><p>availability of a Service Partner;<\/p><p>completion of any required verification;<\/p><p>successful payment where advance payment is applicable.<\/p><p>The Company reserves the right to reject, modify, postpone, reschedule, or cancel any booking without liability where necessary due to:<\/p><p>operational limitations;<\/p><p>weather conditions;<\/p><p>technical failures;<\/p><p>emergencies;<\/p><p>safety concerns;<\/p><p>suspected fraud;<\/p><p>inaccurate customer information;<\/p><p>government restrictions;<\/p><p>force majeure events;<\/p><p>non-availability of Service Partners.<\/p><p>Estimated arrival times are indicative only and shall not constitute guaranteed service commitments.<\/p><br><h2>7. PRICING<\/h2><p>Prices displayed on the Platform are indicative estimates unless expressly stated as fixed-price services.<\/p><p>Final pricing may vary depending upon:<\/p><p>actual scope of work;<\/p><p>service duration;<\/p><p>complexity;<\/p><p>labour required;<\/p><p>location;<\/p><p>emergency requests;<\/p><p>additional materials;<\/p><p>spare parts;<\/p><p>consumables;<\/p><p>customer-requested modifications;<\/p><p>statutory taxes.<\/p><p>No additional work requiring extra payment shall commence without the Customer&#x27;s prior approval, except where immediate action is reasonably necessary to prevent imminent safety risks or further property damage.<\/p><p>The Company reserves the right to revise pricing at any time without prior notice. Such revisions shall not affect bookings already confirmed unless additional work is requested by the Customer.<\/p><br><h2>9. PAYMENTS<\/h2><p>Payments may be made through payment methods approved by the Company, including but not limited to:<\/p><h2>UPI;<\/h2><p>debit cards;<\/p><p>credit cards;<\/p><p>internet banking;<\/p><p>digital wallets;<\/p><p>cash (where permitted);<\/p><p>any other payment methods enabled on the Platform.<\/p><p>The Customer authorizes the Company and its payment service providers to process payments, refunds, reversals, and adjustments relating to bookings.<\/p><p>Failure to complete payment shall entitle the Company to:<\/p><p>suspend ongoing services;<\/p><p>cancel pending bookings;<\/p><p>recover outstanding dues;<\/p><p>suspend promotional benefits;<\/p><p>permanently disable the Customer account where appropriate.<\/p><p>Interest may be charged on overdue amounts to the extent permitted under applicable law.<\/p><br><h2>10. PAYMENT DISPUTES AND CHARGEBACKS<\/h2><p>Where a Customer initiates a payment reversal, bank dispute, chargeback, or payment fraud after services have been rendered, the Company reserves the right to:<\/p><p>suspend the Customer account;<\/p><p>recover outstanding dues through lawful means;<\/p><p>withhold refunds;<\/p><p>recover legal expenses incurred in recovery proceedings;<\/p><p>report fraudulent activity to payment gateways, banks, financial institutions, and competent authorities.<\/p><p>Submission of a chargeback shall not automatically invalidate the Customer&#x27;s contractual payment obligations under these Terms.<\/p><p>Fraudulent payment disputes may result in permanent suspension from the Platform.<\/p><br><h2>11. DIGITAL RECORDS AND ELECTRONIC CONSENT<\/h2><p>The Customer acknowledges and agrees that:<\/p><p>all bookings made through the Platform constitute legally binding electronic records;<\/p><p>electronic confirmations, OTP verifications, emails, SMS messages, WhatsApp communications, in-app notifications, invoices, GPS logs, timestamps, photographs, videos, voice recordings (where legally permissible), chat records, and digital signatures may be relied upon by the Company as evidence of transactions, communications, service delivery, approvals, or disputes;<\/p><p>such electronic records shall have evidentiary value to the fullest extent permitted under the Information Technology Act, 2000 and other applicable laws.<\/p><p>The Customer consents to receiving electronic communications from the Company.<\/p><br><h2>12. RIGHT TO REFUSE OR DISCONTINUE SERVICE<\/h2><p>The Company and Service Partners reserve the right to refuse, postpone, suspend, or discontinue services without liability where:<\/p><p>the premises are unsafe;<\/p><p>abusive, threatening, discriminatory, violent, or inappropriate behaviour is exhibited;<\/p><p>illegal activities are requested;<\/p><p>health or safety risks exist;<\/p><p>fraudulent activity is suspected;<\/p><p>the Customer refuses identity verification where reasonably required;<\/p><p>access to the service location is denied or materially delayed;<\/p><p>statutory or governmental restrictions prevent performance.<\/p><p>In such circumstances, applicable cancellation charges or visit charges may be levied, and no refund shall be payable except where expressly determined by the Company in accordance with its policies.<\/p><br><br><h2>13. CANCELLATION AND RESCHEDULING<\/h2><p>13.1 Cancellation by Customer<\/p><p>Customers may cancel or reschedule a confirmed Booking through the Platform, subject to the Company&#x27;s Cancellation Policy in force at the time of cancellation.<\/p><p>13.2 Applicable Charges<\/p><p>Cancellation or rescheduling charges may apply where:<\/p><p>the assigned Service Partner has commenced travel to the service location;<\/p><p>the Service Partner has arrived at the service location;<\/p><p>the Service Partner is unable to commence or complete the Service due to the Customer&#x27;s absence, incorrect address, inaccessible premises, lack of required utilities, refusal to permit performance of the Service, or any circumstance attributable to the Customer;<\/p><p>repeated last-minute cancellations or rescheduling indicate misuse of the Platform.<\/p><p>Any applicable cancellation or visit charges shall be displayed to the Customer before collection where reasonably practicable.<\/p><p>13.3 Cancellation by the Company<\/p><p>The Company may cancel or reschedule a Booking due to:<\/p><p>operational requirements;<\/p><p>non-availability of a suitable Service Partner;<\/p><p>severe weather;<\/p><p>natural disasters;<\/p><p>technical failures;<\/p><p>public safety concerns;<\/p><p>governmental restrictions;<\/p><p>force majeure events;<\/p><p>suspected fraud or misuse of the Platform; or<\/p><p>any circumstance that may compromise the safety or quality of the Service.<\/p><p>Where payment has already been collected for a Booking cancelled by the Company, the Customer shall ordinarily receive a refund in accordance with the Refund Policy, unless the cancellation resulted from the Customer&#x27;s breach of these Terms.<\/p><p>13.4 Emergency Suspension<\/p><p>The Company or the Service Partner may suspend or discontinue the Service immediately if continuing the Service would create a reasonable risk to the safety of any person or property.<\/p><br><h2>14.
